description: Use when a buyer agent is about to pay an x402 seller it hasn't paid before, or above its usual amount: a signed verdict from what Agoranome holds: the Fair Offer block and certification, the pay-to and since when, OFAC sanctions on it, Google Web Risk on the URL, price against listing and quote, verified deliveries, policy tiers met. Give url= up to 20 times to rank sellers safest first. With tx=, settlement proof: the USDC transfer on Base, Monad or Solana and if it matched the quote. Free: no payment is asked.
